category: prefix lease (ISP, usable in the vendor's AS)

free_tier.stated: No free tier. '119,- € / Monat*' for a /24 of 256 IPv4 addresses, 'zzgl. einmalige Einrichtungsgebühr in Höhe von 49,- €' with the setup fee waived by a limited promotion ('Aktion: 0,-€'), all prices including VAT.
free_tier.notes: The price is per month, includes VAT ('alle Preise inkl. Umsatzsteuern') and is paid in advance for a chosen term of 1, 3, 6 or 12 months. The setup-fee waiver is labelled a promotion ('Begrenzte Aktion' on the home page), so the standing price is EUR 119 a month plus EUR 49 once.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an address block, not an object; the only product is a /24 (256 IPv4 addresses)
per_object_cap.notes: The page sells one block size, '256 IPv4-Adressen'; no smaller or larger prefix is listed.

retention.stated: not applicable: a rented block, not stored bytes; terms of 1, 3, 6 or 12 months paid in advance
retention.notes: The term is chosen at order ('Vertragslaufzeit wahlweise 1, 3, 6 oder 12 Monate bei Vorauszahlung'). unverified: whether the block renews or is released at the end of a term.

egress.terms: not applicable: the page prices the address block only. The block is 'in AS12586 verwendbar' (usable in the vendor's AS), and no transit price or traffic allowance is stated on the page.
egress.free_allowance: not applicable: no traffic is carried by the rental

interface_detail: A management portal ('Verwaltbarkeit über Management-Tool GHOSTnet') where the renter creates its own RIPE handles, network names, descriptions, country, geofeed and name servers; no public API was read.
tooling: The vendor's management portal for RIPE objects, geofeed and name servers; the block is delivered with a route object and RPKI ('Route-Objekt, RPKI, optional LOA') and can be used either with the renter's own ASN or inside the vendor's AS12586, so no ASN of the renter's own is required.
chaining: A rented /24 is 256 addresses in one prefix and one registry object, so it is one rung-3 unit. Because it is usable inside AS12586, the source addresses are announced by the vendor's AS and a renter without an ASN can use them; the registry class of a delivered block is unverified, since none was delivered.

limits.value: one product size: a /24 (256 IPv4 addresses) at EUR 119 per month including VAT, prepaid for 1, 3, 6 or 12 months

limits_note: The vocabulary has no kind for a fixed block size or a prepaid term; volume-quota is the nearest.
binding_note: The single /24 size at EUR 119 a month is the whole purchase; no smaller or larger prefix is offered and the vendor reserves the right to end provisioning for abuse, which the limit vocabulary has no kind for.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the order page's fields were not read. The page states that 'Wir prüfen vor der Bereitstellung Ihre Angaben zur Verwendung der Ressourcen entsprechend RIPE Richtlinien' (the vendor checks the renter's stated use of the resources against RIPE policy before provisioning), that the renter can create its own RIPE handles in the portal, and that the offer is prepaid. Whether a company, card or ID document is required was not readable.

reliability_note: The page states delivery 'max. jedoch nach 24 Stunden' and 'solange vorrätig' (while in stock), so the block is a stocked item.
confidence_note: Documented: the price, the block size, the terms, the AS options and the delivery claim are stated on the vendor's own rental page, captured 2026-11-03. Identity fields and the registry object of a delivered block are unverified, and whether the /24 is the vendor's own space or a third party's is not stated.

extras.role: an ISP that rents a /24 from its own ranges (the page does not say whether the block is its own space or a third party's); not a marketplace on the pages read
extras.price_per_address_month: EUR 0.47 per address per month including VAT
extras.price_derived: EUR 119 / 256 = EUR 0.465 per address per month, VAT included
extras.registries: RIPE NCC (the stated policy check is against RIPE policy)
extras.rung_note: One /24 is one rung-3 unit; the block can be announced from AS12586, so rung 4 depends on that AS and not on the renter. Rung 5 is unverified until a delivered block's registry object is read.
